preconditions.description: The number of mountain heights n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h_j < h_j + 1 for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: The heights h_j must be strictly increasing and non-negative.
Each height h_j must be less than or equal to 10^12.

postconditions.expression: all(h_j >= h_j - 1 for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: After the landslide, the heights h_j must be non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(h_j <= h_j + 1 for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: After the landslide, the heights h_j must be non-increasing by more than 1.
The output must be the final heights h_j separated by spaces.
